Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. content.text: Verifying the checkride billing TOCTOU finding against the actual code.

This confirms the pattern exactly as described in the bill endpoint: SELECT record, check `record.feeBilled` in application code (line 2797-2798), then later `createCheckrideInvoice()` (2847) followed by an unconditional UPDATE setting `feeBilled: true` (2849-2854) — no transaction, no `WHERE feeBilled = false` guard. Let me check the other two endpoints and the schema for a unique constraint.

All three endpoints confirmed identical pattern: `student-signoff` (2947-2982) checks `record.signoffStatus !== 'pending'` (not even `feeBilled`), then invoices, then updates with no `WHERE` guard on the mutable field. `override-signoff` (3049-3082) checks `record.feeBilled` then invoices then updates unconditionally. Now checking schema for a unique constraint.
